englishTranslation: Jelly and faux pomegranate seed dessert
atAGlance: Chè sương sa hạt lựu is a jelly dessert with agar, coconut milk, and faux pomegranate-seed cubes that pop with chewy texture.
whatItIs: Chè sương sa hạt lựu is a chilled jelly-and-coconut dessert where color and chew do most of the work.
howToEnjoy: Stir lightly and scoop across the jellies so you get more than one texture at once.
howLocalsOrder: Order chè sương sa hạt lựu for texture: jelly strands, crunchy ruby-like tapioca bits, coconut milk, and ice. Ask for less ice if you want stronger flavor.
worthKnowing: This is a texture-first dessert, a good reminder that Vietnamese sweets often prize chew and coolness.
goodToKnow: Hạt lựu means pomegranate seeds, but these are usually colorful starch jellies, not real pomegranate.

orderLine.vietnamese: Cho tôi một ly chè sương sa hạt lựu.
orderLine.english: I’d like one glass of jelly and faux pomegranate seed dessert.
orderLine.pronunciation: chaw toy moht lee cheh soong sah hat loo-oo
